warning.titlePre: Mercedes ML350 CDI Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your ML350 CDI has the OM642 diesel V6 — which is the engine fitted to every W164-generation model from 2005 to 2011 — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
